profile.name: United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund, LP

intro.text: The United States 12 Month Natural Gas Fund, LP (“UNL”) is a Delaware limited partnership organized on June 27, 2007. UNL maintains its main business office at 1850 Mt. Diablo Boulevard, Suite 640, Walnut Creek, California 94596. UNL’s shares began trading on November 18, 2009. UNL is a commodity pool that issues limited partnership interests (“shares”) traded on the NYSE Arca, Inc. (the “NYSE Arca”). It operates pursuant to the terms of the Third Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership dated as of December 15, 2017 (as amended from time to time, the “LP Agreement”), which grants full management control to its general partner, United States Commodity Funds LLC (“USCF”).

UNL’s purchase of Futures Contracts other than the Benchmark Futures Contracts and/or Other Natural Gas-Related Investments, if any, depends on various factors, including diversification of UNL’s investments in Futures Contracts with respect to the month of expiration, and the prevailing price volatility of particular contracts.
